kindHints.build_page: build or rebuild the sales page (pageType)
kindHints.publish_page: publish the sales page that is built
kindHints.link_settings: choose where each network's link goes
kindHints.calendar: open the content calendar (postId of a due post)
kindHints.outreach: send outreach emails to partners or past customers
kindHints.code_asset: make a calculator, form or widget (codeKind)
kindHints.listing: list the product on the marketplace
kindHints.brain: teach the app the brand voice
kindHints.offline: something to do outside the app
kindHints.assistant: ask the in-app assistant for help (prompt: the message to type)

new_leads.title: Reply to your {n} new {leads}
new_leads.why: {n} {people} got in touch recently. A quick, personal reply today is the surest way to turn them into customers.

post_due.title: Post today’s planned post
post_due.why: You planned “{headline}” for today. Posting it keeps your calendar on track and your audience warm.

plan_step.title: {title}
plan_step.why: It’s on your plan for week {week}{focus}. Doing it today keeps the plan moving.

no_plan.title: Plan your marketing strategy
no_plan.why: A short plan tells you what to post, which page to build and where to find customers. It takes a few minutes.

new_sale.title: Thank your newest customer
new_sale.why: You made a sale in the last two days. A short thank-you note brings repeat orders and referrals.
new_sale.prompt: Help me write a short, warm thank-you message to a new customer of {brand}.

offer_no_sales.title: Check the page and price of “{offer}”
offer_no_sales.why: {clicks} people clicked this offer in the last 30 days and nobody bought. A clearer page or price can change that.
offer_no_sales.prompt: My offer “{offer}” gets clicks but no sales. Help me check its page and price.

nothing_planned.title: Plan a week of posts
nothing_planned.why: Nothing is planned for the next 7 days. A batch of posts keeps you visible without daily effort.

publish_page.title: Publish your sales page
publish_page.why: Your page is built but not live yet. Publishing it gives every post and profile a place to send people.

build_page.title: Build your sales page
build_page.why: A page that explains what you offer and how to buy or book is where your posts and profiles send people.

lead_magnet.title: Make a free download for your visitors
lead_magnet.why: A free checklist or guide turns visitors who aren’t ready to buy into people you can email.

welcome_emails.title: Write your welcome emails
welcome_emails.why: A few welcome emails greet every new subscriber for you and lead them toward a first purchase.

stale_numbers.title: Update your numbers
stale_numbers.why: Your connected numbers haven’t been updated for a week. Fresh numbers show what’s working.

socials.title: Add your social profiles
socials.why: Your social profiles let the app link your posts and pages together, so people can find you everywhere.

website.title: Add your website address
website.why: With your website address saved, your pages, posts and listings can point people to it.

habit_comments.title: Reply to comments and messages for 15 minutes
habit_comments.why: Answering comments and messages quickly builds trust, and the networks show your posts to more people.

habit_bts.title: Share a behind-the-scenes post
habit_bts.why: Behind-the-scenes posts show the people behind the business and are easy to make on a busy day.

habit_referral.title: Ask a happy customer for a referral
habit_referral.why: Customers who already like you are the best way to find new ones. One friendly ask today is enough.
habit_referral.prompt: Help me write a short message asking a happy customer of {brand} for a referral.
